rides.name: Deep-space probe
rides.reveal: A deep-space probe coasts at about 60,000 km/h.

rides.name: Flying carpet
rides.reveal: A flying carpet cruises at about 50 km/h. The Briefing said gentle, so no top speed.
rides.hint: Wind speeds perfect for a **gentle ride**.

rides.name: Giant eagle
rides.reveal: A giant eagle of the new, faster kind cruises at about 120 km/h.
rides.hint: New and **faster species of large eagles** sighted along the route — be cautious.

rides.name: Time-travelling sports car
rides.reveal: No time travelling, so it's just a sports car at about 140 km/h.

rides.name: Witch's broomstick
rides.reveal: A broomstick, kept to the 60 km/h broom limit.
rides.hint: Brooms must **keep to 60 km/h** in all residential airspace.

rides.name: Reindeer sleigh
rides.reveal: Not a Christmas Eve run, so the sleigh cruises at about 100 km/h.
rides.hint: Reindeer are on **normal duty** today — **no festive speeds**.

rides.name: Unicorn
rides.reveal: A unicorn, told to canter, does about 40 km/h.
rides.hint: Unicorns on this route have been asked to **canter, not gallop**.

rides.name: Rocket roller skates
rides.reveal: Rocket skates at half throttle: about 200 km/h.
rides.hint: Rocket skates are held to **half throttle** on public corridors.

rides.name: Seven-league boots
rides.reveal: Seven leagues a stride, one stride a minute: about 2,000 km/h.
rides.hint: Seven-league boots: **one stride a minute**, no running.

rides.name: A cannonball
rides.reveal: One cannonball at standard muzzle speed: about 1,500 km/h, no slowing down.
rides.hint: One cannon, fired **once**, at **standard muzzle speed**. No air resistance on this route.
